name: Minjara
source:
An artificial god that was created as a weapon 700 years ago.
Since he is an artificial god, the "one [b]Tenken[/b] per person" rule doesn't apply, and can still form a contract by ignoring the rules (double Tenken).

[b]Tenken[/b] is power obtained by forming a contract with [i]God[/i] or [i]Spirit[/i].
Only one person can have one [b]Tenken[/b] and there are various kinds of [b]Tenken[/b] in the world.
[i]Spiritual power[/i] is required to be able to use [b]Tenken[/b].
